description: Source code for the VariableResolution class in Apache Spark SQL Catalyst module, responsible for resolving variable names to expressions, including nested field access and handling session/local variables.

classes.name: VariableResolution
classes.description: Class responsible for resolving multipart variable names into expressions, supporting nested fields and variable scope handling.

methods.name: resolveMultipartName
methods.description: Resolves a multipart name to an expression tree, supporting nested field access, using a longest-match strategy.

methods.name: lookupVariable
methods.description: Looks up a variable by name parts, checking local and session variables.

methods.name: resolveVariable
methods.description: Helper method to resolve a variable considering view context and referred variables.

methods.name: maybeTempVariableName
methods.description: Checks if a nameParts sequence corresponds to a temporary variable name.
